newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE WEDNESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE WEDNESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand rather light.
Wk to date - 62,900 last week - 93,900 last year- 100,900

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00, few 1275 lbs 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs 104.50. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1075 lbs 65.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 104.50.

Sales confirmed on 6,300 slaughter steers and 2,500 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 62,900 head confirmed including 38,000 head or about 60 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
